summary: A reading of Robert Evans's audiobook The War on Everyone, tracing American fascism from British Israelism and Christian Identity through Rockwell, William Pierce's Turner Diaries, Louis Beam, the Order and Oklahoma City to the online radicalisation behind the 2019 mass shootings.

evidence.note: Christian Identity origin traced to Richard Brothers' British Israelite visions in the 1790s
Chapter three becomes a biography of William Pierce, born 1933, through the National Alliance
Turner Diaries plot and influence discussed at length, including an extended quoted passage
Chapter four centres on Louis Beam, Vietnam door gunner turned Texas Klan leader
Klan campaign against Vietnamese fishermen in Seadrift, Texas
Robert Mathews introduced; his Order is the subject of chapter five
McVeigh's Oklahoma City bombing modelled on a Turner Diaries passage
UK nail bomber David Copeland and the murder of MP Jo Cox as a chain of influence
Beam's 1980s Liberty Net and early Usenet neo-Nazi organising open the online chapter
Chapter ends with the 2018-2019 Pittsburgh, Christchurch and Poway attacks

notes: Robert reads his own audiobook, so the author is the host; he is not listed as a primary subject and roles are empty (deviation from the media-reading rule). Format could arguably be deep-dive. Covered start 1794 rests on the British Israelism prehistory of Christian Identity (approximate). The Order and Robert Mathews get a chapter but were left to keywords for the 5-subject cap.
